g.text: OpenSwing: conditional literal Pazy speed curves
Each native mesh subtracts its own gravity baseline. Archived initial-row condition remains unknown. Lines connect saved points; no fit.
Experimental displacement/twist definitions and gravity assumptions remain distinct; this overlay is not an acceptance verdict.
